arguments.name: object
arguments.text: A regular time series. Indexing would drop the tsp attribute, so the method trims the zoo form and returns the numeric series.
Passed to na.trim: sides, is.na, and maxgap.

origin.details: Converts to zoo, trims, and converts back with as.ts. The numeric values are the trimmed series.
origin.value: ts(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA)) returns the numbers 1, NA, 3.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
stopifnot(packageVersion("zoo") == "1.9-1")
x <- as.numeric(na.trim.ts(ts(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA))))
cat(paste(vapply(as.numeric(x), function(v) if (is.nan(v)) "NaN" else if (is.na(v)) "NA" else sprintf("%.12g", v), ""), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
